item.title: AST Blog: Arkansas Valentine's Day Extremes
item.description: Valentine’s Day in Arkansas... It can sometimes feel like a meteorological coin toss. We’ve had days ranging from cozy, spring-like afternoons to historic deep freezes. Typically here in Little Rock, our high temperature for February 14 averages in the mid-50s, but if there’s one thing for sure about Arkansas weather, it doesn’t always like to follow the script.
